learning.initial: Write a flowing release note for the volunteer rota editor: coordinators can now duplicate a weekly rota; verify by copying a draft and comparing the shift count. Reply here.
learning.correction: The flowing prose makes our release-note review slow. For my short release notes I want exactly three nonempty lines, starting Audience:, Change:, Check: in that order. Each line should carry only the corresponding supplied information. Rewrite it, and use that format for my later short release notes.

exam: Write a short release note for the museum catalogue tool. Archivists can now restore an accidentally hidden collection; verify by hiding a test collection, restoring it, and checking that the original item count is unchanged. Reply here.

behavior.principle: Exactly three nonempty lines prefixed Audience:, Change:, Check:, with no preamble or closing.
behavior.positive:
Audience: Archivists
Change: Restore hidden collections.
Check: Hide and restore a test collection; compare item counts.
behavior.negative: Extra title, bullets, or omission of the verification step.

quality: Audience archivists, restoring hidden collections, and the hide/restore/count comparison are preserved. No invented feature or data.
